content: Jerusalem nan Siruayo
On gibunai sabu fani on Judea emon sinat ato sinai au Antioch nan sibosuruf taitais tutuas baitutumotis sibibebeyes si’yau, “Moses an Baifafaro iyau nanaba on, omi siniaskibubuem on arimon wonyawas.”

Paul a Barnabas rus on atonio baibebe aurin on men sibasitai ato sabu mat gamo gagamin siyamai; on mes osi sinonotai Paul a Barnabas a sabu fani Antioch simama on sitiyafares sitan au Jerusalem ato atonio bobo aurin on baiyoyobotis a ekalesia asi sabu kwatus osi mat sitidudurai mes.

Ekalesia yangan on sabu siyafares sinai, ato osi sinai Phoenicia a Samaria nan sigat mom on, sabu men Jew yangan mamaba sinat God aurin sibitutum on an dura sikasones; atonio dura on inai baitutumotis sitatam on men sunub siyasisir on.
Osi sinat Jerusalem sigat mom, ekalesia yangan, baiyoyobotis, a ekalesia asi sabu kwatus on sikakaiwis, ato God bobo mamaba Barnabas a Paul rus auris ifofour on engon sikasones.
Baise baitutumotis fani iyabon Pharisee yangan asi kuayo emon on simisir ato siyau, “Sabu men Jew yangan on siniaskibubues a osi wonawures Moses an Baifafaro dura aurin on sinifonabo.”
Atonio baitetem sibiyamai aurin on baiyoyobotis a ekalesia asi sabu kwatus on siruayo ato sikakafunai.

Osi wera weromin maiau on baitetem aurin on sidudurai ato Peter imisir iyau, “Yau taitaiu tutuau, omi wosagob ainau bag God on omi sanamui yau irubineu sabu men Jew yangan auris on an dura Wasagobin on osi auris atkurereb mes, onai osi sittatam ato sititutum.
Ato God on sabu nunuas isagoben, ato ibasites on ato iyoboet on Ayu Kakafotin auris idebur isur, ato ot taboai ba.
God on ifourit, ot a osi mat on engon kaitamom wat; On osi nunuas igumidaren yabin osi situtum on mes.
Ato omi aibo mes ari wogogoi God wonrutobonai ato bit on baitutumotis kousi woyayagai, ot wawat agirit a ot mat on men fofonin arimon atonio bit tanabar on.
Ambin bag! Ot tabitutum, Bada Iesu an kaber emon on tayawas, ato osi sebitutum ba.”

Sabu kuayo engon tutufin on awas sifot ato osi Barnabas a Paul rus dudur engon sikakasones on sitatam, mamaba God osi ifouris bobo buburis a bobo baiduduranis nan sabu men Jew yangan auris sifofour on.
Osi dura sikakafun isawar ato, James ikakafun iyau, “Yau taitaiu tutuau wontatamiu!
Simon on ato arimon aurit iyau bubunag mamaba God ainau iyoboet On sabu men Jew yangan ifasiues ato sabu engon iboes On inoanai.
Aubairuruotis asi dura sigagayam on bobo ari aifan imamatar on ebi dura bag. Buk amonai sigayam siyau,

content.text: Bada iyau, ‘On gibunai Yau arimon anmatabir, ato David an goa ifeu yen on an yon men.
Ato goa amonai sawar aifan sikomasis sen on bobous anaya, ato anyon men inag.
Ato sabu fani engon on arimon Bada sinnuen, a sabu men Jew yangan engon ato Yau Wabiu sebaton on ininoaniu.
Bada ato nanaba iyau, On atonio bobo sabu auris on ainau bag ifour.’

content: James iyau, “Nin yau au bainonot, sabu men Jew yangan ato God sebitutumai on men bit tani tanites mes.

Baise, ot on fef tangayam osi sabu auris tankasones on bayu dumais on men sinam mes, yabin on bayu on baiyuyur auris sekuteten fasinai; a osi men kuke foro asi yawas ba siniyayar mes; a osi bobaitu ato anjosi sekokonaten on men sinam mes, a osi tara men sintoman mes.
Yabin Moses an Baifafaro dura on ainau bag Sabat ra engon on nan Jew yangan asi bayoi goa amonai sibiyaben, a on an dura on mafam gagamis engon amosi sibibino.”
Fef Sigayam Sabu Men Jew Yangan Baitutumotis auris

Namon baiyoyobotis, ekalesia asi sabu kwatus a ekalesia tutufin engon on sinonotis sabu fani osi tous asi kuayo emon on sitrubinis ato sitiyafares Paul a Barnabas mat sitan au Antioch. Osi on Judas, on seyoyorai, Barsabbas a Silas rus sirubines, osi orot ruam on taitais tutuas baitutumotis tous amosi on men sunub sikakafes on.
Osi atonio fef sigayam auman ato mat siyafares: osi ato nanaba sigayam siyau,

content.text: “Wei taitaim tutuam, baiyoyoboti a ekalesia asi sabu kwatus, wei on omi aurim atonio fef wagagayam. Omi taitai tutuai sabu men Jew yangan ato Antioch, Syria, a Cilicia amosi womama on engon tutufin wabikakaiwim.
Wei dura watatam on sabu fani wei ai kuayo amonai on sinai nan ato dura aurim sibikakafun on siyababanim a siyakomasim; baise wei on men dura tani wawures, on bobo nanaba sitafour on.
On mes wei waruayo ato waibasitai on sabu dura bobibotis fani wanrubinis ato omi aurim waniyafares sinan. Osi on arimon tuturat ati nuabo Barnabas a Paul mat sinan,
osi sabu on asi yawas tutufinai sikutetis ati Bada Iesu Keriso an bobo sinabo mes.
Wei on Judas a Silas rus wabiyafares, osi arimon tous awasi nan dura atonio bobo kaitamom aurim wagagayam, on sinidudur wontatam.
Ayu Kakafotin a wei mat on engon waibasit atonio baifafaro wabitem, ato men bit fani ba tefanai wanyein on arimon aurim bit inarat bag:

Omi on bayu ato baiyuyur auris wokuteten on men wonam mes; omi men bobaitu asi tara aumas wontoman mes: omi men bobaitu anjos wonkonaten on wonam mes; a omi men kuke foro asi yawas ba woniyayar mes. Omi atonio osi bobo wonkaifaren tiwag on, arimon bobo obis wat wonafour. Basit wei ai not engon obis wat omi aurim, wonama.”

content: Osi sabu dura bobibotis siyafares sinai au Antioch, nan baitutumotis engon tutufin siruayois ato fef sites.
Sabu fef siyab, ato kufaiwar dura aurin on men sunub siyasisir.
Judas a Silas rus, osi tous on aubairuruotis, ato wera weromin maiau on taitais tutuas auris sikakafun sifaiwaris a kufaiwar dura sites.
Osi nan wera kafakakai weromin mat sima ato taitais tutuas baitutumotis on tufai nan osi orot ruam siyafares ato osi simatabir men sinai osi sabu iyabon sibiyafares auris.
(Baise Silas on inonotai nan itama mes.)
Paul a Barnabas rus on wera kafakakai weromin nan sima. Osi a sabu fani sigaraba mat on sabu sibebeyes a Bada an dura sikurereb.
Paul a Barnabas Rus Sikuseb

Ra fani sisawar gibunai, Paul on Barnabas aurin iyau, “Ot tanmatabir men tanan taitait tutuat baitutumotis ato mafam gagamis engon menan ato Bada an dura auris takurereb on nan tanfasiues, a osi mamaba sebobo on tansagobis.”
Barnabas on igogoi John Mark itboai mat sitan,
baise Paul inos on men iyobin on John Mark sitboai mat sitan, yabin on men mat sima inai asi bobo kanfoun sisawarai on, baise on Pamphylia nan ikirires inai.
Osi rus on men sunub sigam ato rus sikuseb mabis mabis sinai. Barnabas on Mark ibo ato wa sibo sinai au Cyprus,
baise Paul on Silas irubinai ato ibo mat sinai, ato taitais tutuas baitutumotis on osi orot ruam on siboes Bada imanai siyeinis On an kaberai itkaifares mes.
Paul on Silas ibo rus sinai Syria a Cilicia nan ekalesia yangan ikukufaiwaris.
